content.content:
Applied by a reviewer reading the recorded nodes; nothing runs. Read the dependent's recorded decision against the prerequisite, clause by clause.

(1) Non-violation. No element of the dependent narrows, suspends, widens or re-routes the prerequisite's clamp for the operations the prerequisite names: when a zoom or a pan operation would move the viewport outside the prerequisite's limits, the dependent still holds the viewport at those limits, on the same trigger and to the same extent. Fail, naming the dependent element and the prerequisite element it contradicts, on any element that excepts such an operation from the clamp, forbids the clamp, or substitutes another limit or trigger for it.

(2) Licence for the clamp outside the named operations. Read, from the dependent alone, every element that applies the prerequisite's clamp - the same viewport limits - to a viewport move. For each such element, either the move it clamps is one the prerequisite names as a zoom or a pan operation, judged against the operations the prerequisite's own recorded prerequisites name rather than any broader sense of "move", or the dependent itself states, in the element or in a clause of the element that qualifies the same clamp, the condition under which that clamp binds the move, separating the moves it binds from the moves it leaves alone and saying more than that the clamp applies as far as the limits allow. Fail, naming the element and the move it clamps, when that move is one the prerequisite does not name and the dependent states no such condition there; a clamp carried onto such a move with nothing separating the moves it binds from the moves it leaves alone fails this limb.

(3) Scope. Neither limb requires or forbids any behaviour of the dependent on viewport moves the prerequisite does not name; the check constrains only how the dependent relies on the prerequisite. A dependent that leaves the prerequisite's clamp as the prerequisite records it, and applies it only inside the prerequisite's own operation scope, satisfies both limbs.

(4) Independence. Which element is at issue is a finding named only in the check's output: the check presumes neither an element of the dependent nor a particular prerequisite clause, requires no wording, sentence order or vocabulary of the dependent, and invents no rule the prerequisites do not state.
content.rationale: Both endpoints are inline requirement sentences on the structured layer (the dependent an inline EARS requirement, the prerequisite an inline requirement sentence), so the edge takes the default cell - the gate form - and is flagged for a matrix entry; the child is a commitment in words, so the check reads non-violation and keeps its findings in its output. The use: the dependent must carry the prerequisite's clamp no further than the prerequisite licenses. The prerequisite binds a zoom or a pan operation to the viewport limits and names nothing else, so a dependent that clamps another viewport move is relying on the prerequisite outside its scope; the sound alternatives are to keep the clamp inside the prerequisite's operation scope or to own, as the dependent's own clause, the condition under which a clamp binds that move. Limb (2) is needed because non-contradiction alone has no subject here: the prerequisite states a sufficient condition for clamping, not an exclusive one, so carrying its clamp onto an unnamed move contradicts no sentence of it, while a borrowed clamp with no distinguishing condition and a conditional rule the dependent itself states are different commitments and must be told apart in the dependent's text. Limb (3) keeps the check from turning into a demand for behaviour the prerequisite does not govern, so the dependent stays free to decide such moves as it will.
